headline: DSWD: 305,959 CALABARZON Families Affected by Habagat
seoTitle: 305,959 CALABARZON Families Affected by Habagat | FMB News
seoDescription: DSWD says 305,959 families across 965 CALABARZON barangays have been affected by Habagat, with thousands still in evacuation centers.
deck: The affected areas span Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, Rizal and Quezon, while more than 260,000 family food packs had been distributed.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: DSWD reported that 305,959 families in 965 barangays across CALABARZON had been affected by southwest monsoon rains since early August.
As of noon Sunday, 7,074 families remained in 161 evacuation centers. DSWD said 260,072 family food packs had been distributed.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The affected provinces are Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, Rizal and Quezon. Evacuation numbers rose again on August 29 as heavy rains returned in several areas.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The scale shows that the impact is not limited to isolated flood zones. Relief, health, shelter and recovery needs are spread across a large and densely populated region.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch DSWD and LGU updates for revised counts, relief distribution, road access and instructions for families returning to affected homes.
